title: Orokin Vault/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Lotus transmissions related to Orokin Vaults.
- Lotus: "You've opened an Orokin Vault. It appears unaffected by the Infestation."
- Lotus: "You've unlocked an Orokin Vault. Its... clean."
- Lotus: "You have the Vault artifact, let's go."
- Lotus: "You've got it. Something is different about this artifact..."
- Lotus: "Vault artifact acquired. You'll need to extract before we can verify its function."
- Lotus: "The artifact you are carrying appears to be affecting your Warframe."
- Lotus: "Until we get you to extraction, that artifact will continue to affect your Warframe."
- Lotus: "Your Warframe is being impaired by the artifact."
- Lotus: "It appears that you've triggered security. The Corrupted are here."
- Lotus: "Looks like some Corrupted stayed behind to guard the artifact, it must be valuable."
- Lotus: "The Corrupted will stop at nothing to prevent that artifact from escaping. This won't be easy."
